tail: And David blessed the Lord before the eyes of the whole assembly and David said: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of Israel, our Father from eternity to eternity,
Thine, O Lord, is greatness and might, glory and victory and majesty; with regard to all in heaven and on earth, Thine O Lord, is the dominion and Thou art supreme as head of all.
Wealth and honour are before Thee and Thou art ruler over all and in Thy hand is strength and might and it is in Thy hand to make all great and strong.
And now, our God, we give thanks to Thee and praise Thy glorious Name.
